Water column viewer

Kongsberg EM multibeam water column (EM 124, 304, 712, 2040, ...), one ping at a time: raw beam amplitude (0.5 dB units) against across-track distance and depth.

Files

  • .kmwcd — the water column (#MWC), with position (#SPO) and heading (#SKM) for the time, speed and position shown.
  • .kmall — the same line's bathymetry. Beside the .kmwcd with the same name it supplies the Bottom detections (#MRZ). A .kmall holding water column itself can be opened directly.

Controls

  • Depth min/max, Amp min/max — the depth window and the colour scale range.
  • Across max — a fixed half width so the plot does not jump between pings; 0 fits each ping.
  • Ping slider, its mouse wheel, Left/Right keys — one ping at a time; Replay plays them at Pings / s.
  • Bottom — red = amplitude detection, dark blue = phase, green = rejected; filled = normal, hollow = extra detection.
  • Pick — a left click on the plot records the nearest sample, marks it, and lists it under the plot with the ship's position and the point's own latitude/longitude (azimuth from the heading, else the course over ground). Save as TXT, Remove selected, Clear.
  • Save Image — PNG or JPEG at twice the screen resolution, with the ping's metadata on it.
